answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 slots of compute for an exclusive vertex, ensuring a steady stream of processing power. A verifier monitors ledger occupancy to reject double-committed agents, treating any identity overlap like a dark nebula in the registry. An honest agent pays 1,000 slots, but a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 slot penalty. Identity reuse rises like a plume, triggering a 180-day lock on all collateral until restitution concludes.
